name: Pula Xaoron

Xaoron is the King of Hyoumakai, the underwater kingdom of the Meroid people. He is the protector of the water and can manipulate it at his will. He is one of the Guardians of the Rig Veda legend that tries to stop Barn in his quest. He has a calm tone, but is ruthless in battle.
